image_description: A side-profile view of a bison standing on a paved surface. The image captures the head, prominent shoulder hump, and forequarters in detail. The hindquarters are partially visible but fade out of frame or focus. The fur is thick and shaggy, particularly around the head and shoulders, with a lighter, possibly snow-dusted or frosted appearance on the top of the head/hump.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is clearly visible in profile. It is large and broad. A short, dark, curved horn is visible on the near side. The shape matches the biological description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Beard of long hair on chin and throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A distinct mass of long, dark hair hangs from the chin and throat area, consistent with a bison's beard.
The eye is visible as a dark spot on the side of the head, though partially obscured by fur, it appears anatomically correct.
No large, protruding ears are visible. The area where ears would be is covered in thick fur, consistent with the 'hidden' description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Massive body with exceptionally tall, heavily built proportions at the withers.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The shoulder region (withers) is significantly elevated and massive, creating the characteristic bison silhouette.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Shaggy dark brown fur covering forequarters forming prominent shoulder hump.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The forequarters are covered in thick, textured fur. The shoulder hump is very prominent. Note: There is a white/grey texture on top of the hump/head which looks like frost or snow, not natural fur coloration, but the underlying structure is correct.
The image is cropped such that the rear half of the bison is largely out of frame or extremely blurry. Cannot verify the fur density on the hindquarters.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible horn is short and curved, proportional to the massive head and body.
The legs are visible down to the lower joint, but the feet/hooves are either cut off by the bottom edge of the frame or obscured by the ground/shadow. Cloven hooves cannot be verified.
The tail is located on the hindquarters, which are out of frame.

artifact_observations.location: Top of head and shoulder hump
artifact_observations.reasoning: There is a patch of white/grey, crystalline-looking texture on the top of the bison's head and hump. This resembles digital noise, frost, or an AI hallucination of snow/frost that doesn't match the rest of the environment (which appears to be a dry paved road). It breaks the consistency of the fur texture.

Significant depth-of-field blur is applied. While this can be a photographic choice, in AI images it often masks structural inconsistencies in the rear anatomy. The transition between the sharp foreground and blurred background is slightly soft.
